name: SpendTrace — Capture Purchase
required_device_evidence: Native amount property to text preserves exact value on the target iPhone
Background configuration access after reboot and while locked
Successful live HTTPS pairing and test followed by two real card transactions
Clean installation of the final phone-authored export

pair_device.input: Paste app-generated setup text with separate pairing_url and code fields
checks: Configuration is saved only after a successful response
pair_device.proposed_storage: Shortcuts/SpendTrace-config-v1.txt containing JSON; configuration loaded as the first action, outside distributable template
pair_device.storage_status: Native save/load and failed-pair preservation tested on Mac with synthetic fixtures; physical iPhone validation pending
pair_device.fallback: One import question accepts the complete app-generated device configuration instead of file-based pairing
pair_device.status: Historical manual-copy path in older previews; replaced by same_iphone_connect in the mobile preview.

background_capture.property_names: Confirmed from user iPhone screenshots; six selections must be made once in the iPhone-authoring artifact because this Mac lacks these content types.

wallet_alias.label: Transaction → Card or Pass → Name
wallet_alias.last_four: Omitted: not exposed by inspected input
wallet_alias.network: Omitted: not exposed by inspected input

background_capture.merchant: Actual provided merchant; stop with a useful failure if unavailable
background_capture.amount_decimal: Exact plain signed decimal string. Never use a binary floating-point intermediate, currency formatter, or fixed-decimal rounding. Reject ambiguous locale strings.
background_capture.currency: Supported ISO code only when actually supplied; otherwise JSON null, not the text null
background_capture.event_id: One UUID generated once before the POST; never regenerate when retrying the same event
background_capture.observed_at: Current observation time in yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX format
background_capture.transaction_at: Omit unless a separate actual transaction timestamp is supplied
background_capture.needs_account_message: Observation saved. Choose its payment account in SpendTrace; it is not yet an expense.
background_capture.failure_behavior: Native HTTP/network failures stop execution; validation failures return actionable text. Accepted is checked before success. Capture remains guarded in the iPhone-authoring artifact until publisher selects all six properties.

same_iphone_connect.recognition: Do not assume JSON key order; Shortcuts reorders keys when converting input to text.
mac_checks: setup recognition after native JSON conversion

publisher_steps: Author the native shortcut in Apple's editor using real target-iOS Wallet input; this specification is not a shortcut file
Validate setup, noninteractive capture, exact decimals, null currency, UUID uniqueness, and manual test exclusion
Remove all personal configuration before export or iCloud sharing
Export using File > Export > Anyone, or sign a genuine exported file with shortcuts sign --mode anyone
In the shortcut editor choose Share > Copy iCloud Link > Share
Validate a clean install from that link on a physical iPhone
Configure WALLET_SHORTCUT_URL, a numeric release version, and WALLET_SHORTCUT_VERIFIED=true only after those checks
